name: Buddhist Ruins of Takht-i-Bahi and Neighbouring City Remains at Sahr-i-Bahlol
description: Perched on a rocky hilltop near Mardan in Pakistan's Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province, Takht-i-Bahi is a Buddhist monastery founded in the 1st century CE and used for roughly six centuries. Its height kept invaders away, so courtyards, stupas and monks' cells still stand in remarkable condition. Below lie the walled remains of the small town of Sahr-i-Bahlol.
